name: Girl Inside The Dream
source:
A mysterious girl with very long red hair whom Clavis meets in his dreams. She is quite playful and likes puns. However, her puns are extremely cold.

[Translated from [url=https://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/as/char.htm]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]

[spoiler]Her true identity is Fallen Angel Seraphi. (熾天使セラフィ)
Human Name: Stephanie Ranclay (ステファ＝ランクレー), usually just called "Stepha" [/spoiler]
